luke.21.p1.b1.text: Then Jesus looked up and saw the rich putting their gifts into the treasury,

luke.21.p1.b2.text: and He saw a poor widow put in two small copper coins.

luke.21.p2.b1.text: “Truly I tell you,” … “this poor widow has put in more than all the others.

luke.21.p2.b2.text: For they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.”

luke.21.p3.b1.text: As some of the disciples were remarking how the temple was adorned with beautiful stones and consecrated gifts, Jesus said,

luke.21.p3.b2.text: “As for what you see here, the time will come

luke.21.p3.b3.text: when not one stone will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”

luke.21.p4.b1.text: “Teacher,” … “when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to take place?”

luke.21.p4.b2.text: “See to it that you are not deceived.

luke.21.p4.b3.text: For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and, ‘The time is near.’ Do not follow them.

luke.21.p4.b4.text: When you hear of wars and rebellions, do not be alarmed.

luke.21.p5.b1.text: “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

luke.21.p5.b3.text: famines, and pestilences in various places,

luke.21.p5.b4.text: along with fearful sights and great signs from heaven.

luke.21.p6.b1.text: … they will seize you and persecute you. On account of My name they will deliver you to the synagogues and prisons,

luke.21.p6.b2.text: This will be your opportunity to serve as witnesses.

luke.21.p6.b3.text: So make up your mind not to worry beforehand how to defend yourselves.

luke.21.p6.b4.text: For I will give you speech and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.

luke.21.p7.b1.text: You will be betrayed even by parents and brothers and relatives and friends,

luke.21.p7.b2.text: And you will be hated by everyone because of My name.

luke.21.p7.b3.text: Yet not even a hair of your head will perish.

luke.21.p7.b4.text: By your patient endurance you will gain your souls.

luke.21.p8.b1.text: But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies,

luke.21.p8.b2.text: you will know that her desolation is near.

luke.21.p8.b3.text: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country stay out of the city.

luke.21.p8.b4.text: For these are the days of vengeance, to fulfill all that is written.

luke.21.p9.b1.text: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!

luke.21.p9.b2.text: They will fall by the edge of the sword

luke.21.p9.b3.text: and be led captive into all the nations.

luke.21.p9.b4.text: And Jerusalem will be trodden down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

luke.21.p10.b1.text: There will be signs in the sun and moon and stars,

luke.21.p10.b2.text: and on the earth dismay among the nations, bewildered by the roaring of the sea and the surging of the waves.

luke.21.p10.b3.text: Men will faint from fear and anxiety over what is coming upon the earth,

luke.21.p10.b4.text: When these things begin to happen, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.”

luke.21.p11.b1.text: “Look at the fig tree and all the trees. When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.

luke.21.p11.b2.text: So also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.

luke.21.p11.b3.text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.

luke.21.p12.b1.text: But watch yourselves, … and that day will spring upon you suddenly like a snare.

luke.21.p12.b2.text: So keep watch at all times, and pray … to stand before the Son of Man.”

luke.21.p12.b3.text: Every day Jesus taught at the temple, but every evening He went out to spend the night on the Mount of Olives.

luke.21.p12.b4.text: And early in the morning all the people would come to hear Him at the temple.
